Dear Vendor(s),
This notice is to inform you that Solicitation 36C24626Q0163 for Bulk Oxygen with Tank Rental (Base + 4) has officially been canceled and the requirement will be re-issued at a later date, and all vendors will be notified once the updated solicitation is posted.
We appreciate your interest and thank you for your understanding.
Respectfully,
Ronnie E. Gregory

Hampton VA Medical Center
